newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's Mahart to get Russian ships in debt deal.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's Mahart to get Russian ships in debt deal.

text.p: Hungary's economic cabinet has approved a deal under which the state-owned shipping company Mahart Rt is to receive three ocean-going vessels from Russia, the official MTI news agency quoted infrastructure minister Karoly Lotz as saying on Monday.
The newly-built ships' value of some $50 million will be written off against the debt Russia owes to Hungary from the Soviet era, MTI added.
The economic cabinet is made up of government ministers dealing with economic matters. Its decisions usually have to be approved by the the full council of ministers.
MTI did not say which Russian shipyard would build the vessels.
In 1994, Russia agreed to pay off its $900 million debt to Hungary by the end of 1996 by offering stakes in Russian companies being privatised and by exporting goods.
Russia has so far only repaid $500 million, mostly by exporting military equipment and other machinery to Hungary.
Mahart is expected to be privatised later this year. (( -- Budapest newsroom (36 1) 327 40 40))
